Callout.Name: Aircraft in Distress
Callout.Message: Light aircraft reported in difficulty, may be attempting to land.
Callout.Advisory: Smoke reported from the engine, pilot still in contact.

Script.Line: It came over the trees low and it did not come back up.
I can hear it but I cannot see it. That is the thing.
There is a field behind the barn. If he is putting it down, it will be there.

Lines.Approach: Smoke from the engine and he is trying to put it down. Wherever he lands, we are going.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
